authoredNote: PERL-ONTOLOGY. Written to hold FOUR rules that all failed at once, in the two shapes perl actually writes. SUPERSEDED 2026-10-26 for the code-slot TARGET only: the analyzer publishes the LEAF with `meta.qualifiedAs`, and that is measured (see rationale). The predecessor is kept byte-identical beside this file as `ontology-uses.expectation.superseded-2026-10-26.json`.
rationale: SUPERSESSION RECORD (2026-10-26), measured against the analyzer's own output (script/m14/perl-fixture-divergence.mts): the old file pinned the code-slot rows' targets as the FULLY QUALIFIED name (`Ontology::Reads::handler`, `builtin::is_bool`). The analyzer publishes the LEAF (`handler`, `is_bool`) with the written package in `meta.qualifiedAs`, and that is deliberate at `src/ast/real-perl-analyzer.ts`'s `\&name` branch: 1,267 `\&name` + 278 `\&Pkg::name` sites against 3,618 reference sites whose target is COMPUTED (`\&$cb`, `\&{"Pkg::sub"}`), so a target that trusted the text would have to fabricate one for the computed majority; `\&Pkg::helper` and `\&helper` are the SAME sub and one edge. The passing peer fixture `perl/code-references` already pins the identical leaf contract, so the old qualified-target rows were stale against the tree. THE TWO GAPS the old file named are now IMPLEMENTED and pinned here: (1) `defined &builtin::is_bool` — a code-slot reference the grammar types as a FUNCTION CALL (there is no `refgen_expression` in it), which the call branch correctly refused and nothing else published; the discriminator is the ARGUMENT LIST, not the leading `&`, because `&foo(@args)` is perl's explicit-call syntax; (2) `$Pkg::name` / `@Pkg::name` / `%Pkg::name` — a qualified variable READ, which keeps its FULL qualification because unlike a code slot a package variable has no per-sub binding (`$Foo::LIMIT` and `$Bar::LIMIT` are two globals, and a leaf would collapse them onto one node). The seven forbid rows are the controls: three shapes the file writes and the analyzer must NOT turn into an edge, the line-11 explicit-CALL discrimination narrowed to its own sub, and two rows pinning the QUALIFIED code-slot targets so a silent widening of the leaf rule goes red.
